name: cf
description: Native spec-driven workflows for Claude Code and Codex CLI. Bundles CafeKit skills, runtime hooks, agents, and installer scaffolding.

response_language.title: Response language
response_language.description: Language CafeKit asks Claude to answer in, such as English or Tiếng Việt. Empty follows the user.

address.title: How Claude addresses you
address.description: A short name Claude uses for you; when Claude stops using it, the context was compacted. Empty disables it.
